intent: I designed a balanced sensor array with 5 sensors evenly spaced across the front to maximize line detection coverage, using medium-sized sensors for a good trade-off between resolution and coverage. The wheel track and radius are moderate to balance stability and speed. The body is compact but wide enough to allow some off-track tolerance. Mass is moderate for stable handling. This geometry aims to provide a stable, well-sensed platform for the integrator to develop a fast and accurate line-following controller.
rationale: Starting fresh with no prior integration feedback or race data, I propose a balanced, conservative geometry to maximize line sensing and stable control. I choose 5 sensors spaced evenly across the front, covering left to right, to detect the tape line effectively. Sensor size is medium (0.012 m) to balance resolution and coverage. The wheel track is set moderately wide (0.14 m) for stability, with a medium wheel radius (0.035 m) to balance speed and torque. The body is compact but wide enough (0.14 m width, 0.18 m length) to allow some off-track tolerance without excessive drag. Mass is set at 1.0 kg for stability without excessive inertia. The intent is to provide the integrator a stable, well-sensed platform to develop a controller that can follow the line reliably and quickly. I expect this geometry to yield good line detection and stable handling, enabling the integrator to tune a controller for fast, accurate line following.
